identity.title: Align color-map CI gate with current display verification count

origin.summary: After PL-0027 passed its former failure point, GitHub Actions run 32429997681 exposed a stale exact-count assertion in the C3D grayscale and thermal color-map gate.

state.current_summary: The color-map gate failed only because its workflow expected the superseded 103-check summary. The exact assertion now requires the current passing 111-check result; the complete local gate and repository hygiene pass without production changes.

objective.summary: Restore the C3D grayscale and thermal color-map hosted gate by aligning its exact-count assertion with the current passing display-settings verification contract.
constraints: Do not weaken or remove the exact-count regression assertion.
Do not change product, ViewModel, renderer, or UI behavior for a stale workflow value.
Retain both color-map contract checks, distinct screenshot hashes, height-distribution verification, and screenshot-quality checks.

criteria.text: The workflow requires the current Display-settings ViewModel verification result of 111 checks without weakening the exact-count assertion.

The complete grayscale and thermal color-map gate passes locally with accepted screenshots, required contracts, distinct hashes, Display-settings 111/111, Height Distribution 26/26, and monitor placement evidence.
Workflow/document diff hygiene and durable issue validation pass before the maintenance commit.

context.summary: Contains the stale exact display-settings check-count assertion.
Produces the current passing summary from the actual check collection.

artifacts.summary: Color-map screenshots, contracts, quality reports, display verification, height-distribution report, summary, and monitor evidence.

evidence.observation: The verifier reports Pass (111 checks). The workflow exact-count assertion and summary now require 111 instead of the stale 103, without removing the regression guard.

The full grayscale/thermal gate passed accepted screenshot quality and required contracts for both maps, distinct image hashes, Display-settings 111/111, Height Distribution 26/26, and both 1280x760 windows intersecting DISPLAY2.

evidence.location: git diff --check and proofline issue-ledger validation
evidence.observation: The workflow and documentation diff passed git diff --check, and PL-0028 validated as Proofline v2 before commit.

events.summary: Resolved after the exact workflow expectation was aligned to 111 and the complete local color-map gate passed.
